name: Percentage
description: Percentage: a number of hundredths, so 40 % means 40 out of every 100.

name: Convert between percentages, decimals and fractions
description: convert a number between percentage, decimal and fraction form, in both directions.

name: Calculate a percentage of an amount
description: calculate a given percentage of an amount, such as 15 % of 480 kr.

name: Calculate what percentage one amount is of another
description: calculate what percentage a part is of a whole, and state the answer with the percent sign.

name: Calculate the percentage change between two values
description: calculate by how many percent a value has increased or decreased from an old value to a new one.

name: Percentage point
description: Percentage point: the unit for the difference between two percentages, so a rise from 20 % to 25 % is a rise of 5 percentage points.

name: Explain the difference between percent and percentage points
description: explain whether a change from one percentage to another is described in percent or in percentage points, and calculate both for the same change.

name: Growth factor
description: Growth factor: the number an amount is multiplied by to give its new value after a percentage change; for an increase of p % it is 1 + p/100, and for a decrease of p % it is 1 - p/100.

name: Calculate the growth factor from a percentage
description: calculate the growth factor for a percentage increase or decrease, and read the percentage change from a given growth factor.

name: Calculate a new value with a growth factor
description: calculate the value after a percentage increase or decrease by multiplying by the growth factor.

name: Calculate the original value before a percentage change
description: calculate the value before a percentage change by dividing by the growth factor, and check the answer by going forwards again.

name: Calculate repeated percentage changes
description: calculate the result of several percentage changes in a row by multiplying growth factors, and write the same change repeated n times as a power.

name: Model percentage growth with a digital tool
description: set up a spreadsheet or graphing tool that shows how an amount develops under repeated percentage change, and use it to answer questions such as when the amount passes a given value.

name: Price index
description: Price index: a number that shows the price level in a year compared with a base year, where the base year has index 100.

name: Krone value
description: Krone value: how much one krone is worth in a given year compared with the base year, calculated as 100 divided by the price index.

name: Nominal and real wage
description:
Nominal wage: the wage in kroner as it is paid out.
Real wage: the wage adjusted for price changes, which says how much it can actually buy compared with the base year.

name: Gross and net income
description:
Gross income: income before tax and other deductions.
Net income: what is left to spend after tax and other deductions.

name: Convert prices between years with a price index
description: calculate what a price or wage in one year corresponds to in another year, by setting up the ratio between prices and indices.

name: Calculate krone value from a price index
description: calculate the krone value for a year from its price index, and use it to compare what money could buy in different years.

name: Calculate real wage
description: calculate the real wage from nominal wage and price index, and decide whether purchasing power has risen or fallen between two years.

name: Calculate net income from gross income
description: calculate net income from gross income given a tax percentage or a tax table, and the amount deducted.

name: Explain how price index, krone value and real wage are connected
description: explain why a rising price index lowers the krone value, and why a wage rise can still mean a lower real wage.

name: Budget and accounts
description:
Budget: a plan of expected income and expenses for a period.
Accounts: a record of the income and expenses that actually occurred, to be compared with the budget.

name: Set up a budget in a spreadsheet
description: set up a monthly budget in a spreadsheet with formulas for sums and balance, and adjust it when income or expenses change.

name: Interest and interest rate
description:
Interest: the amount paid for borrowing money, or received for saving it.
Interest rate: the interest for one year as a percentage of the amount.

name: Calculate the growth of savings with interest
description: calculate how much savings with a fixed yearly interest rate have grown to after a number of years.

name: Effective interest rate
description: Effective interest rate: the total yearly cost of a loan or credit, including fees, as a percentage of the amount borrowed; it is the rate to compare when choosing between loans.

name: Serial loan and annuity loan
description:
Instalment: the part of a payment that reduces the debt.
Serial loan: a loan where the instalment is the same each term, so the payment falls as the interest falls.
Annuity loan: a loan where the total payment is the same each term, so the instalment grows as the interest falls.

name: Set up a repayment plan for a loan
description: set up a repayment plan for a serial loan and an annuity loan in a spreadsheet, showing interest, instalment, payment and remaining debt each term, and compare the total cost.

name: Calculate the cost of credit card debt
description: calculate how an unpaid credit card balance grows month by month with its interest rate, and compare it with the cost of a cheaper loan.

name: Assess a personal finance choice
description: assess a choice such as taking up a loan, paying by credit card or saving first, using calculations of cost, and argue for the consequences it has for a budget.

name: Equation and solution
description:
Equation: a statement that two expressions are equal, with one or more unknowns.
Solution: a value of the unknown that makes the two sides equal.

name: Solve a linear equation
description: solve a linear equation with one unknown by doing the same operation on both sides, including equations with fractions, and check the solution.

name: Solve a formula for one of its variables
description: rewrite a formula so that a chosen variable stands alone, such as finding the height from the formula for the area of a triangle.

name: Set up an equation from a practical situation
description: set up an equation that describes a practical situation given in words, solve it, and answer the question in a sentence with units.

name: System of equations
description: System of equations: two equations with two unknowns that must hold at the same time; its solution is the pair of values that satisfies both.

name: Solve a system of equations by calculation
description: solve a system of two linear equations with two unknowns by substitution or by adding the equations, and check the solution in both.

name: Solve a system of equations graphically
description: draw both equations as lines in a graphing tool, read the solution where they cross, and explain why that point solves both.

name: Set up a system of equations from a practical situation
description: set up a system of two equations that describes a practical situation given in words, solve it, and answer the question in a sentence with units.

name: Inequality
description: Inequality: a statement that one expression is greater than, or less than, another; its solution is usually a whole range of values.

name: Solve a linear inequality
description: solve a linear inequality, turning the sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative number, and describe the solution in words.

name: Compare strategies for solving equations
description: solve the same equation or system in more than one way, such as by calculation, by graph or by trying values in a spreadsheet, and argue why each method gives the right answer.

name: Frequency and relative frequency
description:
Frequency: how many times a value or category occurs in a dataset.
Relative frequency: the frequency as a share of all observations, often given as a percentage.

name: Measures of centre
description:
Mean: the sum of all values divided by the number of values.
Median: the middle value when the values are sorted, or the mean of the two middle values.
Mode: the value that occurs most often.

name: Measures of spread
description:
Range: the difference between the largest and the smallest value.
Quartiles: the values that divide the sorted data into four equal parts, with the median as the middle one.
Interquartile range: the difference between the upper and the lower quartile.
Standard deviation: a measure of how far the values typically lie from the mean.

name: Calculate measures of centre
description: calculate mean, median and mode from a list of values and from a frequency table.

name: Calculate the mean of grouped data
description: calculate an estimate of the mean from data grouped in classes, using the midpoint of each class, and explain why it is only an estimate.

name: Calculate range and interquartile range
description: find the range, the quartiles and the interquartile range of a dataset.

name: Calculate standard deviation with a digital tool
description: calculate the standard deviation of a dataset with a spreadsheet or other digital tool, and say what the number tells about the data.

name: Choose suitable measures of centre and spread
description: choose which measure of centre and which measure of spread best describe a given dataset, for example one with extreme values, and justify the choice.

name: Present data in a suitable diagram
description: present data in a bar chart, line chart, pie chart or histogram with a digital tool, and choose the type that suits the data.

name: Analyse and present a dataset
description: analyse a real dataset from the local community or the media in a spreadsheet, using suitable measures and diagrams, and present the findings in writing with a conclusion.

name: Judge a statistical claim in the media
description: judge whether a diagram or a statistical claim in the media gives a fair picture, looking at the axes, the choice of measure, and percent versus percentage points.

name: Convert between units of length, area and volume
description: convert between units of length, area and volume, including litres, and explain why area units change by a factor of 100 and volume units by a factor of 1000.

name: Perimeter, area and volume
description:
Perimeter: the length around a figure.
Area: the size of a surface, measured in square units.
Surface area: the total area of all the faces of a solid.
Volume: the space a solid takes up, measured in cubic units.

name: Calculate perimeter and area of plane figures
description: calculate perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms, trapezia, circles and figures made of these.

name: Calculate volume and surface area of solids
description: calculate volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres.

name: Pythagoras' theorem
description: Pythagoras' theorem: in a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides.

name: Calculate a side with Pythagoras' theorem
description: calculate an unknown side in a right-angled triangle, including a shorter side, and use the theorem to check whether a corner is square.

name: Angle sum in a triangle
description: Angle sum in a triangle: the three angles of any triangle add up to 180°.

name: Similar figures
description:
Similar figures: figures with the same shape, where corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are in the same ratio.
Scale factor: the number every length in one figure is multiplied by to give the corresponding length in the other.

name: Decide whether two triangles are similar
description: decide whether two triangles are similar by comparing angles or side ratios, and identify the corresponding sides.

name: Calculate unknown sides in similar figures
description: calculate an unknown length by setting up the ratio between corresponding sides in similar figures, for example to find the height of a tree from its shadow.

name: Scale
description: Scale: the ratio between a length on a map or drawing and the same length in reality, such as 1 : 50 000.

name: Calculate with scale
description: calculate real lengths from a map or drawing and lengths on a drawing from real ones, and find the scale from two corresponding lengths.

name: Calculate areas from a scale drawing
description: explain why areas change by the square of the scale factor, and use it to find real areas from a map or drawing.

name: Plan a practical task with measurements
description: plan a practical task, such as laying a floor or building from a drawing, by measuring, using scale and calculating the amount and cost of material needed.
